independent_math_assessment.input: x[n]=A exp(rho*(n-n0)) cos(omega*(n-n0)+phi) for n>=n0, n0=4096; zero earlier. Fixtures are mathematical measurement controls, not a reconstructed device signal model.
independent_math_assessment.derivation: With global demodulation omega_c and lambda=rho+i*(omega-omega_c), the positive component before filtering is (A/2) exp(rho*(n-n0)) exp(i*((omega-omega_c)*n-omega*n0+phi)). Causal FIR multiplies it by H(lambda)=sum_j h[j] exp(-lambda*j). The public fit uses t=n-g and extrapolates twice the complex component to t=n0. Its expected amplitude is therefore A exp(i*(phi-omega_c*n0)) exp(lambda*g) H(lambda), exactly the successor's expectation. It is not raw A exp(i*phi).
independent_math_assessment.FIR_and_origin: The exact released1455-tap scaled Hamming100Hz FIR and g=727 are used. Public fitting begins at n=5551, after every convolution term lies inside the post4096 exponential support. Thus the asserted exponential response does not silently assume the onset-truncated convolution is already stationary. The center1005Hz versus tone1000Hz makes omission of the delay phase materially testable.
independent_math_assessment.known_single_control: The single fixture asserts known frequency, log radius and complex-amplitude ratio using the existing published per-mode limits, while retaining the old tighter frequency/radius sanity assertions. Expectations use FIR response and specified input constants rather than fitting those constants from the measured output. Factor-two, omitted global-demodulation phase and omitted delay-factor alternatives each have an explicit rejection assertion. Their pass values remain unknown until execution.
independent_math_assessment.bounded_mixture: Both known1000Hz and4000Hz components, with distinct amplitudes/phases/decays and centers1005/3995Hz, receive the same checks. This is one finite separated mixture; it does not validate arbitrary weak modes, all leakage conditions, hidden components or a statistical error model.
independent_math_assessment.residual_bound: For every undesired signed component, the ratio to the target positive component has magnitude (Aj/At)*abs(Gj/Gt)*exp((rho_j-rho_t)*(n-g-n0)). Its exponential envelope is monotone, so the maximum of the two actual fit endpoints bounds all intervening samples. Summing these nonnegative magnitudes gives a triangle bound for filtered residual, including conjugate images. The endpoint times are728 and11560 relative to n0. This is a deterministic residual bound for the specified fixture, not a confidence interval, bound on fitted parameter error, or bound on actual capture error; the separate fit assertions test parameter recovery for this fixture.
independent_math_assessment.whole_nuisance_control: The mixture and first-tone-only reference share a recoverable target component, but a strong additional component must make both early256-frame relative-RMS checks fail. The exact public whole comparison and returned measurements are retained. This is an appropriate bounded counterexample to target-fit-only equivalence, not proof of rejection of every possible wrong signal.
independent_math_assessment.half_diagnostics: Complex ratios, ratio-minus-one magnitudes and phase differences now supplement magnitude ratios using the same global demodulation/time origin and extrapolation. No half-window acceptance tolerance is introduced. These remain sensitivity descriptions, not calibrated uncertainty, stationarity or repeatability proof.
